literal: mood having-known time having-considered dislike without desirable-things pleasingly to-speak.
translation: Understanding the mood and considering the right time, one should speak desirable things that cause no offense, in a pleasing manner.
modern: அரசரின் மனக்குறிப்பை அறிந்து, ஏற்ற காலத்தையும் கருதி, வெறுப்பு தராத தேவையான காரியங்களை அவர் விரும்பும் வகையில் சொல்ல வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises on how to speak to a ruler or a person in power. First, one must gauge their current mood ('குறிப்பு') and choose the appropriate time ('காலம்'). Then, the words spoken should be useful and desirable ('வேண்டுப'), free from anything that might cause offense ('வெறுப்பு இல'), and delivered in a way that pleases the listener ('வேட்ப'). The word 'வேட்ப' emphasizes that even necessary advice must be presented attractively.
